name: Jojo-a-GoGo
source:
This game was made as a part of the 2016 NaNoRenO game jam.
You play Jojo, a rabbit that is stage managing her school's winter show.
Some Features Include:
- Three characters to meet
- Seven endings
- 4000+ words 
- Teenage awkwardness
- Pixel art

[From [url=https://whatnames.itch.io/jojo-a-gogo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作为2016年NaNoRenO游戏创作活动的一部分而制作。
你将扮演兔子Jojo，负责学校冬季演出的舞台管理。
部分特色包括：
－三名可结识的角色
－七种结局
－4000余词
－青春期的尴尬
－像素美术

[摘自[url=https://whatnames.itch.io/jojo-a-gogo]Itch.io[/url]]
